notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Stuff': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so no starting Effect is set.
Prince Xizor is posted once in the starting section and once under Characters, so the deck has 2.
Total is 60 as published (8 starting + 5 locations + 17 characters + 5 starships + 14 interrupts + 10 effects + 1 podracer); 5 Emperor Palpatine is as posted.
Posted 'Coruscant', 'Coruscant Imperial City' and 'Coruscant Docking Bay' dested the Dark Special Edition printings (the post is from June 2001, before the Coruscant set).
Twi'lek Advisor is the Jabba's Palace interrupt; Secret Plans is the Special Edition Effect (not a Defensive Shield in 2001).
No Coruscant-set cards are listed, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
